<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Your system exceeds the current license limits. Please acquire a license to continue using all features.</span></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Your system has been over license limits for an extended period. The system will stop working soon if a valid license is not acquired.</span></div>

## Why it happens

The system has more of something than the licence allows, for example after a smaller licence was activated. A warning shows for the first 7 days, then a critical warning until day 15. After that the system is blocked ([ST-LIC-005](/docs/troubleshooting/errors/st-lic-005/)).

## Fix it

Before the grace period ends, either delete entities until you are under every limit, or activate a licence with higher limits. The dialog lists what is over the limit.

## Check that it worked

The warning no longer shows after you sign in again.
